notes.title: 09.02.2021 Update Notes
notes.content:
Now Arcade machine is playable
 Fixed an exception where drivers would drop the last cargo
 Customers no longer wait far for the table to empty
 Information panel now appears when loading a cargo into small vehicles like bicycle
 Buyed vehicle save load system changed
 Buyable cameras added to maps

notes.title: 08.31.2021 Update Notes
notes.content:
Forklift network sync improved
 Fixed a bug where an employee was not actually fired when fired
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the vehicle to get stuck when adding cargo to vehicles such as bicycles
 Now if your vehicle falls under the ground, it returns to its home position.
 The vehicle ui is no longer open if you leave the game while in the vehicle and re-enter
 Crosshair now be visible if you leave and re-enter the game while in the vehicle
 Now you can sell vehicle while they are carrying something
 Now you can pick cargo from bicycle etc
 Fixed sometimes preventing data such as character position from being saved
 Now when the host leaves the game, it also throws you into the menu
 Fixed a bug that prevented the TV from being used

notes.title: 08.29.2021 Update Notes
notes.content:
No longer day time will be saved or loaded in sandbox mode
 Now when client joins, server synchronize old variables to the client
 Buildable trash can added
 Profit graph bug fixed, now it can be seen when day is over
 Drone physics improved
 Now are you sure panel is showing when click new save
 Now when prices is high and if customer get angry then you lose reputation too
 The character no longer attacks while building.
 Job durations added to workers, its visible on workers while doing a job
 Worker levels added Clumsy, Normal, Talented, Expert
 Now, when employees perform a task, they check whether another employee has undertaken that task.
 On client customer position sync bug fixed

notes.title: 08.24.2021 Update Notes
notes.content:
Now, two people can get on the vehicles you bought from the dealer.
 Now, crypto values syncing on clients correctly
 Now, player can put cargoes to shelf too
 Toilet objects have been added as purchasable, now you need to make an area for employees to use the toilet
 Urine added to workers and players you need to pee when your urine bar fills
 Energy added to players
 Added room to garage map
 Added info to snappable shop items
 You can no longer rank with what you do in sandbox mode.
 Pricing panel added to computer, when prices are low customers be happy with chance. when prices are high customers be angry with chance

notes.title: 08.23.2021 Update Notes
notes.content:
Now Active Advertisements will synced when clients join
 Now Active Debts will synced when clients join
 Now Vehicle Doors will synced when clients join
 Now Active Upgrades will synced when clients join
 Traffic system now will synced on clients
 Now when playing on sandbox maps, reputation, hunger and thirst sliders disabling
 Now workers can sit chairs when they are idle
 Now lifters and stackers can spawn on small vehicle park
 We can no longer zoom in-out when using forklift and stacker, because it conflicts with forklift function
 Now when the save is loaded, the packages in the packaging phase are spawned again
 Bigger sandbox map added

notes.title: 08.20.2021 Update Notes
notes.content:
Now, if we leave the game while in the vehicle, when we re-enter, we start at home like the vehicles.
 Now the customers can sit on the chairs, and we can too.
 Fixed a bug that prevented purchased vehicles from being driven
 Vehicle controls improved
 Idle customers no longer go to the admin room.
 Now drivers use stackers.
 Employees can now take a cigarette break.
 Cargoes now spawn large or small according to their weight
 Added texts to show areas on the map as you approach

notes.title: Update Notes 08.15.2021
notes.content:
Sandbox Mode Added
 If you fire an employee while holding a box, the box in his hand would be untouchable, this bug has been fixed
 Fixed a visual bug that caused customers to bring boxes without holding them in multiplayer mode.
 Now, Truck can carry 3 pallets, Van can carry 2 pallets.
 Fixed an unsnappable conveyor
 The direction of the conveyors is now better understood
 Added crypto mining machine. $1000
 Now the crypto panel is updated instantly after your transaction
 Fixed a bug that prevented your cryptos from loading
 Navigation improvements
 Lobby passwords now hided
 Multiplayer client side improvements
